summary: Full Fase 1 (auth foundation) testing of E-KERTALANGU. Backend: 27 pytest cases against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering login (email/username/phone), cookie/JWT behaviour, brute-force lockout, refresh, logout, bcrypt hash format, /qr/public caching, QR registration + duplicate handling, activation, self-reset, and admin user list/delete/role endpoints -> 25 passed (92.6%). Frontend: Playwright on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) covering login for all 3 roles, password toggle, wrong-password toast, role-card visibility per role, /roles route protection, Ganti Akun logout, admin area (QR panel + user list + delete buttons), pengurus/peserta 'Segera Hadir' placeholder, reset dialog (change + restore password), QR registration via /register?token=, duplicate 409 toast and invalid activation code -> all flows passed. Seeded credentials verified intact after testing.

critical.issue: ACCOUNT TAKEOVER: self-reset only checks that 'peserta' is present in user.roles. The seeded admin has roles [admin, pengurus, peserta], so posting {phone: 081100000001, dob: 1990-01-01, new_password: X} returned 200 and actually changed the ADMIN password (and bumped token_version, killing the admin session). Same hole applies to pengurus (roles include peserta). Fix: reject when roles intersect {admin, pengurus} (i.e. only allow when roles == ['peserta']), and consider rate-limiting self-reset by phone.

minor.issue: Non-ObjectId path param raises bson.errors.InvalidId -> HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (traceback in backend.err.log). Should be 400/404. PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/roles has the same unguarded ObjectId(user_id) call.
No validation of email format, phone format or password strength (RegisterInput uses plain str). Also 'dob' and 'address' accept any string; a 1-char password is accepted.

Lockout is keyed on ip:identifier, so an attacker can bypass it by alternating identifier forms (email vs username vs phone) for the same account - each form gets its own 5-attempt budget. Consider keying on resolved user id.

Requires a valid access token (Depends(get_current_user)); once the 15-min access token expires, logout returns 401 and the refresh cookie is never cleared. Logout should be idempotent/unauthenticated-safe and should also invalidate token_version.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (RoleArea)' - a navigate()/setState is called during render (reproduced by opening /area/admin as a peserta account). Move the redirect into a useEffect or return <Navigate/>.

issues: Date of birth uses the raw browser native date picker (<input type=date>) instead of a shadcn Calendar/date-picker; on mobile it renders as MM/DD/YYYY which is confusing for an Indonesian audience expecting DD-MM-YYYY.
User name block is hidden below sm breakpoint (text-user-name has 'hidden sm:block'), so on mobile only an avatar shows with no name/role text - the spec asks for name + avatar top-right.
QR image testid is 'admin-qr-image' while the spec/handoff notes list 'img-public-qr' (that id only exists on /register). Not a bug, but testid naming is inconsistent across pages.

action_items: CRITICAL: restrict /api/auth/self-reset so accounts holding admin/pengurus roles cannot be reset (currently allows full admin account takeover with phone + dob).
Guard ObjectId(user_id) in DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} and PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/roles to return 400/404 instead of 500.
Fix setState-during-render in RoleArea.jsx (unauthorized role redirect) to remove the React warning.
Add Pydantic validation (email/phone format, min password length) to RegisterInput and SelfResetInput.
Make POST /api/auth/logout work without a valid access token and clear both cookies.
Consider keying login lockout on the resolved user instead of the raw identifier string.
Optional UI: replace native date inputs with shadcn date picker; show user name on mobile header.
critical_code_review_comments: self_reset(): the 'peserta' in roles check is insufficient for multi-role accounts - use set(roles) == {'peserta'}.
admin_delete_user/admin_update_roles: ObjectId(user_id) is called on unvalidated input -> 500.
login(): lock_key = f'{ip}:{ident}' means the same account has independent lockout counters per identifier variant.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers.
public_user() correctly strips _id and password_hash - verified no _id/password_hash leaks in /admin/users or /auth/me responses.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (1 React console warning)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary QR-registered users with emails *@example.test and names TEST_* ; all deleted via admin API after testing. Verified only the 3 seeded accounts remain and all 3 seeded passwords still work (Admin#2026 / Pengurus#2026 / Peserta#2026).
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present and accurate; all 3 accounts verified working after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. Two tests are expected to fail until fixed: test_self_reset_cannot_target_admin_account (admin takeover) and test_admin_delete_invalid_objectid (500). NOTE: the self-reset test intentionally resets the admin password and restores it in a finally block; if that test is interrupted the admin password may be left as 'Xtemp#12345' - restart the backend (seed_users re-syncs the admin password from ADMIN_PASSWORD) to recover. Backend uses httpOnly cookies -> always use requests.Session(). Public QR token is cached in app_settings and persists across restarts.
rca_of_the_issue: self_reset() gates on `'peserta' not in user.roles`. Because seeded admin/pengurus accounts include 'peserta' in their role list (multi-role design), the gate passes for privileged accounts, allowing anyone who knows the phone number and date of birth to set a new password for the admin account. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/self-reset {"phone":"081100000001","dob":"1990-01-01","new_password":"X"} -> 200 and admin login with the new password succeeds. Mitigation: require the account's role set to be exactly ['peserta'] (or add an explicit 'self_reset_allowed' flag).
